mapper.sql: r.id AS review_id, r.content, r.images, r.rating_score, r.visited_at, r.created_at, r.updated_at, p.id AS place_id, p.name AS place_name, p.category_name, p.category_group_code, p.road_address_name, p.x, p.y, u.id AS author_id, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.handle AS author_handle, u.profile_image AS author_profile_image, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM likes l WHERE l.review_id = r.id ) AS like_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.review_id = r.id ) AS comment_count, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM likes ml WHERE ml.review_id = r.id AND ml.user_id = #{viewerId} ) AS liked_by_me
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews ( id, content, images, rating_score, visited_at, place_id, user_id ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{content}, #{images, typeHandler=com.ssafy.gourming.typehandler.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{ratingScore}, #{visitedAt}, #{placeId}, #{userId} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, content, images, rating_score, visited_at, place_id, user_id, created_at, updated_at FROM reviews WHERE id = #{reviewId}

SELECT
FROM reviews r JOIN places p ON p.id = r.place_id JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.id = #{reviewId}

SELECT
FROM reviews r JOIN places p ON p.id = r.place_id JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.place_id = #{placeId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT
FROM reviews r JOIN places p ON p.id = r.place_id JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
